title: Bike & Spa: the 12 Spas Tour by bike, a break on the Gleichenberg cycle route R45 | s’Genussplatz’l
description: Bike & Spa, the 12 Spas Tour: 469 km in 13 stages through the Thermen- & Vulkanland, Slovenia and a short stretch of Croatia. s’Genussplatz’l in Unterpurkla on the Gleichenberg cycle route R45 is a partner of the Interreg project.
